text='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    sequences=[[2,1,3,8],[4,5,6,7]]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v=grid[r][c]
            if not v: continue
            neighbors=sum(0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]!=0 for rr,cc in [(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)])
            if neighbors: continue
            seq=next((s for s in sequences if v in s),None)
            if seq is None: continue
            start=c-seq.index(v)
            for j,x in enumerate(seq):
                cc=start+j
                if 0<=cc<w: out[r][cc]=x
    return out
'''
